display current-configuration
#
 version 7.1.064, Release 5489P02
#
 sysname AC-1
#
 clock timezone beijing add 08:00:00
#
wlan service-template corp
 ssid Corp
 vlan 100
 akm mode dot1x
 cipher-suite ccmp
 security-ie rsn
 client-security authentication-mode dot1x
 dot1x domain corp-domain
 service-template enable
#
wlan service-template staff
 ssid Staff
 vlan 200
 akm mode psk
 preshared-key pass-phrase cipher $c$3$SECRET
 cipher-suite ccmp
 cipher-suite tkip
 security-ie rsn
 security-ie wpa
 client-security authentication-mode mac
 mac-authentication domain staff-domain
 service-template enable
#
wlan service-template guest
 ssid Guest
 client-security authentication-mode mac
 client-security ignore-authentication
 mac-authentication domain portal-domain
 portal enable method direct
 portal domain portal-domain
 portal apply web-server web1
 service-template enable
#
radius scheme rad
 primary authentication 198.51.100.5
 primary accounting 198.51.100.5
 secondary authentication 198.51.100.6 key cipher $c$3$SECRET
 key authentication cipher $c$3$SECRET
 nas-ip 198.51.100.1
#
domain corp-domain
 authentication lan-access radius-scheme rad
#
domain staff-domain
 authentication lan-access radius-scheme rad
#
domain portal-domain
 authentication portal radius-scheme rad
#
 domain default enable corp-domain
#
portal web-server web1
 url http://portal.example.com/login
#
return
<AC-1>
